# A Content-ID alone no longer makes unnamed plain text an attachment

The original 1910 branch returned a name for any Content-ID. Current code requires a nonempty name for that related-attachment branch, then lets ordinary unmarked text return null. A later current task expects zero attachments and one inline text part for a plain text message with Content-ID and no name. That later check is comparison context only, not complete study of its introducing revision; it also skips IMAP. This is static source inspection. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: WebExtension named related parts.
